newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN V AEK ATHENS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN V AEK ATHENS TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Thursdays European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final first leg match between holders Paris St Germain of France and AEK Athens of Greece on Thursday:

Paris St Germain - 1-Bernard Lama; 13-Laurent Fournier, 4-Bruno N'Gotty, 6-Paul Le Guen, 2-Daniel Kenedy; 12-Bernard Allou, 15-Benoit Cauet, 10-Rai, 7-Leonardo; 9-Julio Cesar Dely Valdes, 11-Patrice Loko.

AEK Athens - 1-Ilias Atmatsidis; 25-Vassilios Borbokis, 3-Nikos Kostenoglou, 12-Stelios Manolas, 21-Michalis Kassapis; 2-Triantafylos Macheridis, 6-Michalis Vlachos, 8-Toni Savevski, 7-Timour Ketspayia; 9-Daniel Batista, 11-Demis Nikolaidis.
